# Eurostat inward FATS: persons employed in foreign- and US-controlled enterprises, ICT and R&D industries (fats_g1a_08)

Foreign control of enterprises by economic activity, 2008-2020: persons employed (V16110) in all enterprises (WORLD), in enterprises controlled from outside the reporting country (WRL_X_REP) and in US-controlled enterprises; NACE Rev.2 J, J62, J63 and M72; EU countries, the United Kingdom (to 2017) and other reporting countries. Dataset DOI 10.2908/FATS_G1A_08.
